g.aria-label: Three Real-World Conditions That Break Raw Accuracy
1. Class Imbalance (Rare Positives, π = 1%) [99% trivial acc]
True negatives (TN) swamp the denominator while all positives are missed
2. Asymmetric Error Costs (κ_FN ≫ κ_FP) [100:1 cost ratio]
Missing a cancer diagnosis costs far more than ordering a follow-up lab test
Cost thresholds act directly on p̂, failing if the model is overconfident
